chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Mahbub from Abu Ayyub from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)
Regarding the people of the jizya (poll tax), is anything taken from their wealth and livestock besides the jizya? He said, 'No.'

key_terms.أَهْلِ الْجِزْيَةِ: People of the jizya (non-Muslim subjects paying poll tax)

ai.seo_question: What is the scope of taxation for non-Muslims under Islamic governance according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith from Imam al-Baqir (AS) clarifies the fiscal rights of the *ahl al-jizya*, establishing that the jizya is a comprehensive levy for protection and thus precludes additional arbitrary exactions from their wealth or livestock. This ruling underscores the principle of contractual fairness in Islamic governance, ensuring that non-Muslim subjects are not burdened with double taxation beyond the agreed-upon poll tax.
